mechanism: Prednisone may increase fluphenazine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and increases risk of extrapyramidal side effects and metabolic complications; fluphenazine may increase seizure risk in predisposed patients on corticosteroids.
action: Monitor for extrapyramidal symptoms, metabolic effects, and seizure activity; consider dose adjustment of fluphenazine if prednisone doses are high or prolonged.
